verdict.rationale: monday.com documents linking GitHub/GitLab pull requests to items and makes a generic claim of 2-way sync with "any platform." Real-time event subscriptions and a GraphQL API would let an engineer build a custom sync. However, nothing shows a native, bi-directional sync with a repository's issue tracker: PR linking is one-way context, not issue sync. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented two-way GitHub/GitLab issue sync, field/status mapping details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that the sync works.
